name: Cumin Steak with Yellow Rice, Tomato-Cucumber Salad & Garlic Sauce

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water, turmeric, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice cucumbers; transfer to a medium bowl.
Medium dice tomatoes and add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Peel and small dice onion; add to the bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the garlic sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
¾ tsp garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide rice, salad, and steak between plates. Serve with garlic sauce on the side and enjoy!
